coverage_limit: Stroke or diagnostic atomic-face footprint, not reconstruction silhouette correctness. Atomic nested faces include material islands and potential voids.
metric_geometry_scope: Default topology/contour metrics describe ALL preserved P/S proposals including unintegrated strokes. Region SVG shows only integrated atomic faces; separate integrated_only metrics below. A filled region is not inferred from successful stroke rendering.
